integrity: The claim is derived directly from the displayed SDE, the stated independence of its Wiener components, the simulation diffusion amplitudes, and the standard Itô covariance-to-Fokker--Planck formula. A same-author predecessor with an explicit scalar transmission-noise driver was inspected as a comparison.
scientific_limitations: The result identifies a covariance-level mismatch between the stated transmission-rate interpretation and the published independent-noise SDE. It does not recompute the optimal controls, quantify downstream numerical changes, or assess unrelated boundary and notation issues.
title: Independent transmission noises are not transmission-rate noise
